Name: Prettier Cherry Tree
Author: Honeyyfaerie
Description: mod that changes the cherry tree from a purple shade to pink. Keeps the same general vibe of Stardew valley, just with a pinker hue. When playing I found the shade of the cherry tree to bother me every time I went by it, especially with the other mods I have installed that change the saturated pallate of the game. This doesn't change much, just that pesky tree for people like me lol
